answer_1.quote: Spoken-to-written style conversion can be formulated as a monolingual translation task, mapping from a spoken style text to a normalized written style text.
answer_1.outputs: normalized written style texts from spoken style inputs

answer_2.quote: We evaluated models with BLEU and ROUGE-L. Referring to most grammatical error correction tasks, we also used the word-based MaxMatch scorer to calculate P/R/F values.

answer_4.quote: The results from human evaluation are based on the accuracy of the first round of annotation.
answer_4.guideline: The senior annotators then perform a comparative analysis of the results from both rounds and issue the final annotation verdict.
